name: vox-halftone-cutout
label: Vox B&W newspaper halftone cutouts + thick white scissor outline + constructivist yellow/cutting-mat collage
source: refs/: Mayakovsky constructivist slice, halftone clipboard hand cutout, and Vox dark cutting-mat archival frame

headline.font: Impact, Oswald, Franklin Gothic Bold, sans-serif

imagePrompt: Cutout archival newspaper photograph of {subject}, strictly black and white greyscale coarse newspaper halftone dot print (Ben-Day screen dots, high contrast newsprint ink), surrounded by a thick irregular angular hand-scissored solid white paper border outline (#FFFFFF), layered over a torn vintage book page with deckle fibrous edges and a bold cadmium yellow (#F2B705) geometric constructivist paper strip accent, resting on a dark teal architectural self-healing cutting mat grid (#123544) or matte slate cardstock (#3B4652), deep realistic drop shadows between paper layers, generous negative space, tactile stop-motion cut-paper documentary collage aesthetic, 8K, no text, no watermark
elementPrompt: single isolated black and white coarse newspaper halftone print cut-out of {subject}, Ben-Day screen dots, high contrast monochrome newsprint ink, surrounded by a thick irregular angular hand-scissored solid white paper border outline (#FFFFFF), plain pure white background, no text, no watermark
negative: full color subject, 3d render, CGI gloss, smooth gradient skin, neon, plastic, watermark, logo, blurry

motion.headline: word
rules: Every scene is a tactile paper stack on either a dark teal cutting mat (#123544) with protractor grid or slate/sage cardstock (#3B4652/#C8CCC1) with torn vintage book pages (#EAE0C8) and binder-clipped graph paper.
All photographic subjects are strictly 100% B&W coarse newspaper halftone prints with a thick 10-14px hand-scissored white paper outline (#FFFFFF) and crisp drop shadow.
Constructivist horizontal slicing (Mayakovsky technique) offsets a horizontal band across the hero cutout backed by a Cadmium Yellow (#F2B705) paper strip.
Physical fasteners (metal binder clips, silver wire paperclips slipped over cutout edges, corner scissors/pen props) ground the scale.
Ransom-note cutout typewriter letters on white squares and hand-drawn charcoal scribbles/dashed arrows complete the collage.
avoid: flat digital rectangles without paper grain or fasteners
